Package org.osgi.test.cases.zigbee.mock

Class ZCLFrameRaw

java.lang.Object
org.osgi.test.cases.zigbee.mock.ZigBeeSerializer
org.osgi.test.cases.zigbee.mock.ZCLFrameImpl
org.osgi.test.cases.zigbee.mock.ZCLFrameRaw
All Implemented Interfaces:
ZCLFrame
public class ZCLFrameRaw extends ZCLFrameImpl implements ZCLFrame
ZCLFrame implementation class that may be initialized with a specific raw frame (the ZCLFramImpl class accepts only the ZCL frame payload and not a full frame). This implementation of the ZCLFrame interface ensures that the getBytes() returns the raw frame used in the constructor, but also that it is possible to unmashal it using the ZCLFrame ZCLFrame.getDataOutput() and its returned ZigBeeDataOutput stream.
